items.prompt: For c=3, run PUSH 0, PUSH -2, POP, POP, POP. Which outputs follow?

options.why: Zero is a stored payload and must be returned, not treated as absence.
Indexes determine occupancy; zero and negative values keep their FIFO positions.
There are two usable slots, so both pushes succeed.
Returning the last pushed value first would be LIFO rather than FIFO.
